purpose: Teach: 対人/竹下/地主/産ん/取り出す/昌/キツイ/岬

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、対人練習の心理学本読んでたな
lines.en: Hey, I saw you reading that psychology book about interpersonal communication.
lines.style: Casual observation, slight teasing lilt. Not accusatory — more like she caught him doing something she finds interesting. Light, conversational pace. The kind of noticing that feels like she's actually paying attention.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会で竹下内閣の話覚えたろ、桜
lines.en: Yeah, and you were memorizing stuff about the Takeshita cabinet in history the other day, Sakura.
lines.style: Easy deflection wrapped in a counter-observation. Quick, almost playful comeback. Not defensive — more like he's testing if she'll admit she's been watching him too. Slight smirk in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会で地主制度習ったろ
lines.en: Riku, you totally covered the feudal land system in social studies.
lines.style: Casual redirect, pressing a point she thinks he'll dodge. Matter-of-fact tone — not aggressive, just stating what she observed. She's enjoying the back-and-forth.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ペットの猫が子猫を産んで嬉しそうだったな、桜
lines.en: And you were really happy when your cat had kittens, Sakura.
lines.style: Softer now. A genuine memory. Not mean-spirited — almost tender underneath the deflection. Like he's reminding her that he notices the things that matter, not just her studying habits.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、引き出しから教科書を取り出すの忘れたろ
lines.en: You forgot to grab your textbook out of your desk drawer yesterday.
lines.style: Dry, matter-of-fact call-out. No triumph in it — just stating a fact she probably knows. Fast, lightweight delivery. The kind of observation that's closer to concern than teasing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、隣のクラスの昌くんと話してたな、桜
lines.en: I saw you talking to Sho from the next class over the other day, Sakura.
lines.style: Casual mention, watching her reaction. Not quite as soft as before but still not antagonistic. He's curious whether she'll volunteer information or dodge like he does. Even pace, curious edge.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、部活の練習がキツイって言ってたな
lines.en: You said club practice has been really brutal lately.
lines.style: Quieter memory, almost gentle. He's offering something back — something he actually paid attention to because it mattered. No teasing here. Direct, sincere.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、家族で岬の灯台行ったろ、桜
lines.en: Your family went to that lighthouse out on the cape, didn't they?
lines.style: Soft, genuine curiosity. Final gentle volley — he's showing he's been noticing her too, in the same way. Warm close, not competitive. Waiting to see if she'll soften.
